notes.title: High School Dirty Secrets - Play the demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Step into the chilling halls of Kasuga’s high school in this exclusive Steam Next Fest demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42986576/56567c42b863caf277e1bff949213f0396e0bcc7.png

Trapped with no memory of how she got there, she must navigate eerie corridors, decode cryptic messages, and uncover dark secrets lurking within. Will you help her escape… or become part of the mystery?

Download the demo now and add the game to your wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115490?utm_souce=jandu&utm_campaign=snf2025&utm_medium=steamevent
